svg.aria-label: The same corridor with the five roles at their places and the five current approaches, each with its limit. The professional, the recruiter and the hiring manager sit along the corridor, the head of people stands above it beside a board of skills categories and the automated screen with its filters, a coach and a public employment counter stand in front, a writing aid sits at the professional side and the regulator and auditor stand beside the corridor. Between the folder and the screen is a narrow slot through which one thin sheet passes.
svg.title: The situation: five roles, five approaches and a thin hand-off between folder and screen
